---
title: "Feedback 1"
date: "2025-11-07"
---

![Image post thumbnail](thumbnail.jpg)

So far I don't have a lot to say. I think that the class is pretty open ended. We meet once a week as a class and outside of that you have objectives you must complete on your own time. I have found it helpful to visit with your readers often to get feedback.

Now that I have reviewed a couple of papers I think that has been one of the most useful exercises that we have done as somebody else looking at your work can allow for them to catch mistakes that you might not otherwise find yourself. Also being able to look at other peoples work gives a better idea of things you could od in your own paper.
